text_block_list.text:
As I'm discussing the day's training
schedule with
Кинг Хало, a sudden noise
interrupts me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Thunk!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: OUCH!!! Geez, that hurt!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Having banged her own head on the
desk, King
Halo appears angry at
herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
O-of course not! I was just practicing

headbutting!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, we need to be focusing on
today's
training plan!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: ...So where were we again?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I knew it. She fell asleep in the middle of
our
conversation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Gosh, there's no need for your concern.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Well, I did add a little bit of personal training to my schedule...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But only second-rates would admit
defeat this
early!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I shall endure the pain, overcome the
hardships,
and better myself! Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Seeing as you're my trainer, I expect you
to be on
the same page. Now then, let's
get to training!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Goodbye to the old me, hello to the
new me!
Victory is calling my name!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Now, what kind of training will it be
today? Let's
go over it one more time!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Today's plan is to take a nap on the grass.
We're doing some light training today.

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? I believe I told you that this
level of
fatigue is no problem at all.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Shh, just come with me for a minute.

text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on! I've already prepared
myself to
start running!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
You want me to lie down here and take
a nap?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Very well, then. I suppose even if I don't
actually
fall asleep, relaxing still has its
benefits.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'll resume training after the short break,

understood?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Sigh... But I suppose it's not so bad lying down and gazing at the sky like this. Hehe...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Ah!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I-I wasn't sleeping, you know! I was just
relaxing!
For an extended period of
time!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, I'm going all out! I need to
make up
for today's lost time!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
What?! Didn't I just say that only
second-rates
give up this early?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Being first-rate means never giving up! It
means
moving forward even when the
going gets tough!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list:
I understand, but let's try it and see how it
goes.

text_block_list.text: Sigh. Fine, but if I feel this isn't enough, then I'm taking matters into my own hands.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
This should feel... far less strenuous...
than usual...
but my body won't move...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: This is just right, considering how tired you are.

text_block_list.text: Ugh!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I mean, ohohoho! Don't go getting the
wrong
idea about all this!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
This was a test! That's right, a test! To
make sure
you won't let your trainee
behave recklessly!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
You assigned me training that was
appropriate
for my condition... Quite a
fine response. I
present you with a
passing grade!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! And with that, I am done for
the day!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: ...Phew. I'm quite ready for a rest...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
This light dose of training proved to be
more than
enough for Кинг Хало today.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Following her deep sleep, Кинг Хало is
brimming
with energy and motivation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
